repair_targets.goal: Reduce manuscript-level skeletonized dramatization across separated high-stakes scenes without padding or destroying effective minimalism.
method_constraints: Preserve concise scenes where specific object, bodily constraint, silence or irreversible choice already carries emotion.
Change scene grammar, resistance, perception, timing, subtext and consequence rather than merely adding description.
Audit cross-scene recurrence after functional masking.

repair_targets.goal: Repair author-shaped live information packaging around the located early warning line while preserving the actual new meta-information.
method_constraints: Allow environment, interruption, inference or later completion to carry information.
Do not repair with filler particles, fake stammering or slang.

repair_targets.goal: Give Liu Sanniang's return a textually available pre-return decision delta rather than inferring motive from rescue actions after she is already back.
method_constraints: Do not use old affection or mere proximity as the only new reason.
Keep the trigger proportionate and non-expository.

repair_targets.goal: Increase target-reader page-turn pull and experiential climax crescendo without merely adding combat, deaths or louder prose.
method_constraints: Compress or transform spans where event progress exceeds reader-state change.
Escalate through prediction, personal convergence, irreversible choice and changed consequence.
Preserve strong existing peaks but make the intended terminal sequence earn its position experientially.

repair_targets.goal: Increase black-arrow mystery answer-specific curiosity rather than relying on danger/action alone.
method_constraints: Make clues create a cared-about prediction, trust/relationship reclassification or consequential choice.
Use fair evidence and model updates; do not withhold arbitrary facts.
Test answer-value ablation: revealing the answer early should materially reduce a meaningful part of suspense pull.

non_goals: Do not rewrite plot merely to satisfy gate vocabulary.
Do not imitate source-book prose or living-author style.
Do not apply Novel DNA unless a separate router call explicitly authorizes it; GN-VDNA-01 remains default off.
Do not commit manuscript prose to the public repository.
Do not declare final freeze or close human failures inside the repair run.
required_outputs: privacy-safe repair ledger mapping every material change to TR-F01..TR-F05 and any Phase359 supporting finding
self-audit identifying unresolved risks without claiming target-reader closure
next_after_completion: Preserve revised manuscript and repair ledger, then run a new post-repair validation phase on the new SHA. Architecture generalization must be tested later on a separate uncontaminated manuscript holdout.
